The image depicts a stainless steel microwave oven with an integrated toaster oven, accompanied by a toaster oven door open to reveal a bread roll inside.

The microwave oven features a digital display on the left side, showcasing the time "12:24". On the right side, a row of buttons is arranged horizontally, labeled from left to right: "Defrost", "Weight", "Timer", "Start", "Power Level", "Cook", "Reheat",
